note: Rewritten from Chhotani (1997), who transcribed the description of Roonwal and Sen-Sarma (1960); the original is in English, soldier and worker known, alate unknown; the original records the minor worker only as 'similar to the major worker but smaller', without measurements; literature citations, figure numbers and distribution are omitted.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Frontal projection of the soldier weak or sometimes absent, frons steeply sloping anteriorly; mandibles long and sword-shaped, relatively straight and thick, each with a median, lateral pointed tooth; postmentum arched in lateral view, robust and club-shaped. Alate not described.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule straw yellow; antennae and labrum paler than the head; body yellowish white. Head and body with numerous hairs. Body length 3.3–3.9 mm. Head capsule subrectangular to oval; head length to mandible base 0.85–0.93 mm, maximum width 0.75–0.78 mm; head relatively thick, height 0.60–0.65 mm, height/width ratio 0.80–0.87. Frontal projection weak, sometimes absent; frons steeply sloping anteriorly. Fontanelle distinct, situated at the point where the frons begins to slope, distance from occiput to fontanelle 0.75–0.80 mm; fontanelle gland large and distinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segment 3 shorter than segment 2 and nearly equal to or shorter than segment 4. Labrum tongue-shaped, apex pointed; length 0.15–0.18 mm, width 0.20 mm. Mandibles long, sword-shaped, relatively straight and thick, apex sharply curved inward; length nearly equal to head length (0.88–0.95 mm), left mandible length/head length ratio 0.94–1.07; outer margin straight or weakly curved inward; each mandible with a median, lateral pointed tooth (tooth distance 0.48–0.55 mm, left tooth distance/mandible length ratio 0.51–0.59). Postmentum swollen, arched in lateral view; robust and club-shaped, length 0.45–0.50 mm, maximum width 0.25 mm, narrowest at the waist 0.15–0.175 mm. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin with a distinct to weak notch; length 0.25 mm, width 0.45–0.50 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Dimorphic. Major worker: head capsule pale yellow; antennae, legs and body yellowish white. Body length about 3.0–3.5 mm. Head capsule subquadrate; head length to mandible base 0.70–0.80 mm, maximum width 0.70–0.83 mm. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 3 and 4 nearly equal in length, segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4. Postclypeus raised, length about half its width; anterior margin straight, posterior margin rounded. Pronotum saddle-shaped, length 0.25 mm, width 0.50–0.53 mm. Minor worker: similar to the major worker but smaller.
